detail.longDescription: 🐘 NEW: In # Kenya ’s # MountElgon region, researchers interviewed scouts and elders living alongside salt-mining # elephants . The accounts describe elephants choosing particular # plants when unwell, and mothers mixing chewed plant material into # milk for their # calves . The team identified 35 plant species the # animals use, 25 with known local medicinal value. 👉 https:// zurl.co/coszl # elephants # wildlife # animals # science # conservation # medicinalplants # biology # nature # research # ecology # africa
